description:
Adds an item group. ItemGroup objects represent items that are grouped together for fast entry, and an ItemGroupRef aggregate refers to one of these item groups. In a request, if an ItemGroupRef aggregate includes both `full_name` and `list_id`, `full_name` will be ignored. You can use an ItemGroupQuery request to get information about all the item groups that are set up in the QuickBooks file.

The `item_group_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3000 invalid_object_id, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3100 name_in_use, 3120 object_not_found, 3140 invalid_reference, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account
